title: Hydrophobic model systems for oil film photooxidation: part I: sensitizer effects on hydrocarbon photodegradation
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00809C, Paper
Manoj P. Rayaroth, Bin Wu, Christoph Aeppli
Photochemical degradation is a significant pathway controlling the fate of surface oil following marine oil spills; however, the mechanisms governing transformation in oil films remain poorly understood due to the complexity of crude oil mixtures.
